title: AI Product Ad Templates for Photos and Videos | AIVideosUGC
description: Find AI product ad templates for photos and short videos. Choose a style, add one product photo, and get a new asset for your store or social feed.
h1: AI Product Ad Templates: See It, Recreate It, Launch It
lead: Get a product ad ready faster: pick a template, add your product photo, and download an asset for your store, social feed, or campaign.
card: Ready-made styles for product photos and videos. Pick one, add your product, and publish the next asset.

faq.q: How do I choose a product ad template?
faq.a: Start with the buyer moment you need: a product showcase, explainer, UGC-style ad, or social post.

faq.q: Can I adapt a product ad template to my own product?
faq.a: Yes. Upload one clear product photo, choose a template, then compare the result with the item you sell before publishing.

faq.q: Which video lengths can I choose?
faq.a: Video jobs are available in 6, 10, 15, and 30 seconds.
Photos are square by default. Crop a downloaded still for the channel where you will use it.

faq.q: Can I use a product ad template for an Amazon listing?
faq.a: Yes. Start with a clean product photo template, then check the current Amazon category rules.

faq.q: Can I add a price, code, or headline?
faq.a: Yes. Add exact campaign text after download in your usual editor.

faq.q: Will the result keep my product shape and color?
faq.a: Yes, it keeps the shape and color. Compare the downloaded result with the item you sell before publishing.

faq.q: Do I need editing experience to start?
faq.a: No. Upload a product photo, choose a template, and download the result for your usual editor.

m2.h2: How to Use Product Ad Templates in 3 Simple Steps

m3.h2: Pick a Product Ad Template for Your Next Campaign

steps.d: Add one photo of the item you sell. The template keeps the product at the center.
Choose a photo or video style for the channel you use. The right format keeps the result easy to place.
Download the new asset and add it to your store, social feed, or ad campaign.
